title: Sennacherib's Honey and God's Deliverance of Jerusalem
description: The Assyrian king Sennacherib sends servants and letters to mock the Lord and intimidate Jerusalem into surrender. King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah cry out to heaven, and the Lord sends an angel who destroys the Assyrian army. Sennacherib returns home in shame and is killed by his own sons in the house of his god.
